papers.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models
papers.abstract: Omnimodal world model generating synchronized 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech while following continuous 6-DoF navigation trajectories across first- and third-person views.

papers.title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
papers.abstract: Proposes scaling law linking data size to tokenization capacity for user behavior modeling, introducing adaptive tokenization method ALGN to improve efficiency in billion-scale scenarios.

papers.title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: ERPO replaces action-side policy regularization with input-side query distribution control to stabilize reinforcement learning for language models while preserving response exploration.

papers.title: AutoResearch: Insight In, Hallucination Out
papers.abstract: Two-stage autonomous system grounding research ideas through integrated generation and evidence-based execution to improve experimental reliability and measurable outcomes.

papers.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
papers.abstract: Quantization-aware healing recovers compressed 4-bit language models faster and more stably than QAT by distilling directly from original uncompressed models.

papers.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
papers.abstract: Sandbox and benchmark with 507 policy-conditioned workflows for evaluating agent reliability in stateful business tasks, revealing gap between occasional success and consistent completion.

papers.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks
papers.abstract: EvoMap externalizes verified execution experience into reusable structured Gene, improving long-workflow task completion and reducing token costs across diverse models.

papers.title: Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports
papers.abstract: End-to-end pipeline creating instruction-tuning datasets from industrial technical reports, with 13.6k QA pairs enabling fine-tuning improvements from 28.5% to 42.0% accuracy.

papers.title: The Laws of Context Allocation: Causal Measurement and Closed-Loop Orchestration in Generative Search
papers.abstract: Causal measurement probe and iterative submodular scheduling overcome evidence-utilization and context-allocation bottlenecks in retrieval-augmented generation portfolio synthesis.

papers.title: Hybrid Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Privacy-Aware Federated Biosignal Learning
papers.abstract: Quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold network improves federated ECG classification accuracy with 37.35% fewer parameters and 24.89% lower communication costs than MLP.
